finalIdentity.scope: post-run artifact and current-source byte identity only; not signing, installer-inner-payload, native launch, functional, performance, or release qualification

scope.renderer: Browser-emulated Tauri renderer against a mock IPC fixture; visual and renderer performance evidence is not native packaged-app evidence.
scope.backendPerformance: Debug-profile backend benchmark using controlled generated queue/journal workloads; it is not a release-profile or native UI measurement.
scope.playlistPerformance: Rust batch-admission harness with generated playlist fixtures; it measures durable backend admission and does not include renderer transfer or paint.
scope.native: No native packaged execution was performed. The packaged-build receipt proves construction only; native acceptance is paused. Renderer native-scaling qualification remains exactly as reported by the visual comparator.
scope.soak: Backend and renderer long-duration outcomes are preserved from the explicitly supplied soak receipts.
scope.historicalLimitations: Earlier matched backend and diagnostic receipts are historical findings only. They are not counted as final performance, soak, package, or native evidence.

frontend.units: milliseconds unless a metric states otherwise

backend.units: preserved per row from each backend comparison report
